description: Ministry of City Planning, Water Supply & Higher Education - Order to acquire the lands in D/S Division's Minipe 8 Mawathagama
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It describes the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land allotments) for water supply projects, including detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, and claimants. This falls under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition and property matters for public infrastructure projects.
